blinding_guess.why: The plugin casts Gazebo sensor pointers with boost::shared_dynamic_cast (five call sites) rather than boost::dynamic_pointer_cast; from general knowledge (not checked here) shared_dynamic_cast is the deprecated form that newer Boost releases dropped, so the build depends on an older Boost. Whether this counts as a defect depends on the Boost version the consumer builds against.
